description: This file defines the `LoanProductTrancheDetails` class, which is an embeddable domain object used within loan product configurations in the Fineract platform. It encapsulates details related to loan tranche disbursal such as multi-disbursement permission, maximum tranche count, and outstanding loan balance.

classes.name: LoanProductTrancheDetails
classes.description: Represents tranche-specific details for a loan product, including disbursal policies and limits.

methods.description: Constructor to initialize all fields of `LoanProductTrancheDetails`.
